characters.name: Presenter
characters.voice_notes: Warm, professional radio presenter. Calm, measured, friendly.
characters.key_line: "Welcome to World Watch. Today we meet a volunteer from the Green Garden Project."

turns.line: Welcome to World Watch. Today we meet a volunteer from the Green Garden Project.
Thanks for having me. It's great to be here.
Tell us, what is the Green Garden Project?
It's a charity in our area. We turned an old wasteland into a garden for the community. Children play there now.
How did you first get involved?
A neighbor encouraged me to join. Before that, I didn't really know people here. Now I know everyone.
So you got to know your community.
Exactly. We respect each other's rights, and everyone helps. It's a good cause.
Why is a green space important for a city?
Pollution is a big problem in cities. Green spaces give us cleaner air. They're good for our health too.
Does the project help with bigger problems?
Yes. Some families here live in poverty. The garden gives them fresh food. It helps with hunger and gives children an education about food.
You mentioned teaching. How did you learn to grow vegetables?
I taught myself! I made mistakes at first, but I didn't blame myself. You learn by trying.
You're running a fundraising campaign now, right?
Yes. We want to buy more plants and equipment. A local company just donated a large sum of money.
In a world full of conflict, this garden brings people together.
That's true. Everyone is welcome in the garden.
How can our listeners help?
Come and volunteer! You can donate too. Every small effort makes a difference.
Thanks, Tom. The Green Garden Project — what a great story.
Thank you. The garden is open to everyone.
